{{Quote|I was able to learn more about those who lead the Meatlumps. Their names are Hraykken, Draykken, and Louis Bender. They are indeed brothers. Together they founded the Meatlumps and shaped their gang into what it is today.|[[Vani Korr]], excerpt of ''[[Who are the Meatlumps?]]''|<ref name="SWG:HVKItM">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Help Vani Korr Investigate the Meatlumps|Corellia}}</ref>}}
'''Hraykken Bender''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a leader of the [[Meatlumps]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Destroying droids is one of my favorite things to do. Or to be more precise, sending other people out to destroy droids.|Hraykken Bender, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RAL" />}}
Hraykken Bender was the son of [[Lucien Bender]] and the brother of [[Draykken Bender|Draykken]] and [[Louis Bender]]. Lucien Bender was a mad scientist who used to conduct experiments on his own sons. However, prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the three young boys managed to escape their abusive father with the help of a [[Meatlump King|mysterious individual]] who would later become the [[Meatlump King]]. This man adopted the three boys and raised them as his own.<ref name="SWG:B">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Bountied!|Corellia}}</ref> After [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] assassins attempted to kill their adopted father, the Bender brothers founded the [[Meatlumps]],<ref name="CDHZ">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80113|text=CorSec Database H-Z|int=CorSec Database H-Z}}</ref> a gang of fanatical technology-hating thugs, criminals and terrorists.<ref name="Meatlumps">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67782&month=052008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Meatlumps!}}</ref> While the Meatlump King became the ideological and public leader of the Meatlumps, the Bender brothers handled the daily operational details of the gang activities. They were based in a secret [[Meatlump Hideout|hideout]] located beneath the city of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]]. It was Draykken Bender who named the Meatlumps after their [[Meatlump (food)|favorite food]].<ref name="SWG:MtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Meet the Meatlumps|Corellia}}</ref> In response, their father Lucien created the [[Bofa Treat Gang]], also named after food.<ref name="SWG:B" />

By the time of the Battle of Yavin, two Imperial officers, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tery]] and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Frost (colonel)|Frost]], discovered that the three Meatlump leaders were in fact three brothers. Analyzing the Meatlump attacks against Imperial researchers, Frost and Tery hypothesized that the father of the three brothers could have been himself an Imperial scientist at some point.<ref name="SWG:RMR">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|RE: Meatlump Research...}}</ref> Later, the [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Vani Korr]] of ''[[Corellia Times]]'' confirmed their conclusion and revealed the filiation of the three brothers in the article ''[[Who are the Meatlumps?]]''.<ref name="SWG:HVKItM" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Hraykken and Draykken decided to attack a [[Helper droid factory|droid factory]] that manufactured helper [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on Corellia. They dispatcher a spacer affiliated with the Meatlumps to attack the factory. The spacer was successful in destroying most droids, including the "droid queen" [[QU3-3N]].<ref name="SWG:RAL" /> A short time later, the spacer finally killed Lucien Bender who had placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his three sons.<ref name="SWG:B" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hraykken Bender was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RAL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The three Bender brothers &mdash; Hraykken, Draykken and Louis &mdash; were first mentioned in [[Vani Korr]]'s article ''[[Who are the Meatlumps?]]'', introduced in the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," released on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> They were later mentioned in web articles related to the Meatlumps on the ''Star Wars Galaxies'' website: the "[[CorSec Database H-Z]]," published on [[June 16]], [[2006]],<ref name="CDHZ" /> and "Meatlumps!", published on [[May 30]], [[2008]],<ref name="Meatlumps" /> as well as during the events of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]],"<ref name="SWG:MtM" /> released on [[June 19]], 2008.<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref> Finally, the three Bender brothers were added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 10|Game Update 10]]," released on [[June 2]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=927421|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10}}</ref>

[[File:Hamm.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Cut depiction of Hamm who eventually became Hraykken Bender.]]
In the "CorSec Database H-Z", the Bender brothers were originally described as the sons of the Meatlump King.<ref name="CDHZ" /> However, it was revealed with the Game Update 10 that they were in fact adopted by the Meatlump King after escaping Lucien Bender, their biological father.<ref name="SWG:B" />

Analysis of unused game files added with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]" indicated that the three Bender brothers were intended to be named Lempi, Lucien and Hamm, while the father should have been named Andrade.<ref>{{GalaxiesNGE}} &mdash; tyrena_meatlump_brothers.stf</ref> The game's files also contain unused graphical models of Hamm and other Meatlump brothers. These files indicate that Lempi became Draykken Bender, Hamm became Hraykken Bender and Lucien eventually became Louis Bender.<ref>{{GalaxiesNGE}} &mdash; meatlump_brother_lempi.iff, meatlump_brother_hamm.iff, meatlump_brother_lucien.iff</ref>
